intro: Amber welcomes you with warmth and comfort, just like your home. Its sturdy top and strong wooden legs offer lasting beauty, making every meal a chance to share, connect, and create memories.

features.title: MDF top with marble-look finish
features.text: Polished, sophisticated, and made for you. The MDF tabletop with a marble-look finish brings refined style that complements your space beautifully.

features.title: UV coating for durability
features.text: Life gets messy—we’ve got you covered. The UV-protected finish adds resistance to everyday wear and tear, ensuring long-lasting beauty.

features.title: Solid rubberwood base
features.text: Built for the long haul—the solid rubberwood base delivers exceptional strength you’ll appreciate for years to come.

features.title: Warm cappuccino wood legs
features.text: Elegance meets warmth—cappuccino-coloured wood legs give your dining space a refined, cosy feel.

features.title: Enhanced durability
features.text: We built this with you in mind—a thick tabletop ensures strength and support for everyday dining.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
